minutes.label: Focus session, minutes
minutes.description: Starting length. The wheel changes it by five.

sessions.label: Focus sessions a day
sessions.description: The day's goal. 0: no goal, sessions are only counted.

break_minutes.label: Break, minutes
break_minutes.description: A break begins when a session ends. 0: no breaks, and Paws asks for none.

long_break.label: Long break, minutes
long_break.description: The break after every fourth session of the day. 0: like the others.

break_due.label: Break overdue after, minutes
break_due.description: Paws asks for a break this long after the last one.

look_away.label: Look away
look_away.description: In a session, every 20 minutes Paws looks out of a window for 20 seconds. So should you.

glasses.label: Glasses of water a day
glasses.description: Paws gets thirsty at even gaps through the working day until this many are logged.

lunch_from.label: Lunch, from
lunch_from.description: From this time on, until you eat or say you have.

meal_minutes.label: A meal, minutes
meal_minutes.description: The break Paws begins for lunch. It counts as lunch after ten minutes.

day_start.label: Working day, from
day_start.description: From this time on a press wakes Paws.

day_end.label: Working day, to
day_end.description: Paws sleeps from this time to the start of the working day.

remind_end.label: Remind me when the day ends
remind_end.description: Paws says the day is done and waits for OK before it sleeps.

weekends_off.label: Weekends off
weekends_off.description: On Saturday and Sunday Paws sleeps and asks for nothing.

smoking.label: Smoke breaks
smoking.description: Adds a smoke break to the kinds of break. Paws coughs, and counts them for the day.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: A sound when a session or a break ends, and when the day does.
